validations.title: ICD-10 diagnosis vs. procedure
validations.description: Checks that each billed procedure matches the ICD-10 diagnosis of the account, for example no knee surgery for a respiratory diagnosis.

validations.title: Authorization check
validations.description: Checks that the services that need a prior authorization from the payer have one, and that it covers the billed dates and amounts.

validations.title: Supporting documents
validations.description: Checks that the account brings the documents the agreement checklist asks for (invoice, claim form, clinical notes…) before it is analyzed.

validations.title: Tariff variance vs. agreement
validations.description: Compares each billed amount with the agreed tariff and flags the differences beyond the allowed tolerance.
